abilities.name: Ember Vigil
abilities.text: Once per round, when scenario pressure would rise on your turn, you may take 1 Wound to reduce that increase by 1.

abilities.name: Ash Psalm
abilities.text: After you clear a dangerous, ember, or sanctuary sector, record 1 Vow Note.

abilities.name: Bone Bell
abilities.text: Once per round, when a Wound or failed test would raise scenario pressure on your turn, record 1 Vow Note.

abilities.name: Cinder Oath
abilities.text: Spend 1 Vow Note before a scenario confrontation test to add +2. Weakness: Vow Notes cannot be used for shop, salvage, or Contract rewards.
